notebooks.summary: Revised analysis of autocatalytic reaction networks and stoichiometric memory conditions based on newly collected literature.

Autocatalytic reaction networks can be characterized by algebraic conditions on submatrices of the stoichiometric matrix supporting irreducible systems. [peer-9250d8312060bab87b36ebec]

notebooks.title: Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
notebooks.summary: Heritability in prebiotic chemical systems depends on overcoming error and fidelity thresholds that govern whether compositional patterns can persist across generations.
notebooks.findings: Heritability and evolutionary dynamics can theoretically emerge in non-equilibrium chemical reaction networks prior to the development of templated genes. [peer-21edf144b7e5b0cbb2af7775]
notebooks.limitations: Models rely heavily on theoretical stoichiometric formulations and idealized noise assumptions; empirical validation across complex wet-lab environments remains limited.
notebooks.next_questions: What specific experimental parameters distinguish true compositional heredity from transient stoichiometric relaxation in fluctuating reactors?
